name: cp_ash
extra: Images 2 and 3 are approved trees from this game, a lime and an old oak, shown at the game's pixel size: draw the leaves as image 2 does, in clear clumps of 3 to 4 flat shades each, every clump with a lit top and a darker underside; the bark a warm brown ramp whose edge is a darker brown. No black and no near-black anywhere. The brightest leaf shade is a warm orange-gold, never light yellow or white.
subject: a tall old ash tree in golden autumn, seen from the front: a straight grey-brown trunk with a diamond bark pattern and a slightly flared foot, long limbs reaching up and out to the right into one broad mass of autumn ash leaves in large rounded clumps, golden amber and warm orange with a few olive-gold clumps, small gaps between the clumps where brown branches show, lit from the upper left
part_map: the dark grey column is the trunk (exactly that width and height, it touches the ground line), the mid grey bars are the main limbs going up and right into the crown, the big light grey shape is the leafy crown: fill it to its edge with irregular leaf clumps on the outline, keep the underside at that height, and let the crown run out of the top edge of the image, cut by the frame like a big tree seen close up.
size_sentence: the trunk is about as wide as the dog's head is tall, and the lowest leaves hang about two and a half dog heights above the ground. It is a big old tree, far taller and wider than the image on the right, so its top is not seen.

slot.where: City Park tall, the ASH at x 1916 (screen 6 right edge, screen 7), its crown over the alder walk; drawn by Sc.drawTreetops
